assets.name: Briar Sanctum
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: AshenSpire local exploration map, landscape 1536x1024. Create an original premium dark fantasy painterly environment map. High elevated three-quarter cartographic view, terrain fills frame with no sky or horizon, consistent miniature architectural scale, readable branching pale stone footpaths and two alternative routes connecting foreground entrance to main upper destination. Weathered charcoal stone and iron, antique gold accents, restrained color, hand-painted tactile brushwork and fine architectural detail. Clear spatial hierarchy with quiet path areas suitable for later UI overlays. No text, letters, labels, frames, compass, symbols, UI, route dots, characters or watermark. No baked gameplay fog. Reference image is STYLE AND CAMERA context only; create a completely different location, do not duplicate Bellfoundry layout. Subject: Briar Sanctum in The Hollow Weald. A ruined circular gothic sanctuary grown into an enormous dead tree amid dense ancient woodland, interwoven thorn roots and olive moss. Central root-choked cloister, roofless side chapels, shallow dark stream crossed by two old stone bridges, winding paths through broken grave terraces and forest clearings, foreground ruined gate. Muted olive foliage, scattered burgundy leaves, warm antique gold shrine metal, charcoal trunks. Main sanctuary fully visible upper center; no bell tower, industrial furnaces or snow. Every path should be visibly walkable; preserve openings between trees.
